title: The Whole TOWN Hides At 9:09 🕘
description:
In our town, everyone is inside by nine oh-nine, every night. The bakery shuts a minute early. Mr. Tran walks his dog at a run. Nobody knows why, and nobody asks.

On Tuesday my bus broke down two miles out, and I didn't make it home in time.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
